source_read: the five menu PDFs linked from https://www.notcutts.co.uk/restaurants/sample-menu (SS26 Breakfast, Lunch, Children's, Drinks; AW26 Festive Feast), downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (robots.txt allows /media/ and /restaurants/); byte-identical to the copies data/source was built from
not_verifiable: allergens: Notcutts publishes no allergen guide (calories-only chain, no allergens.csv), so none were compared
notes: Calories-only chain. Re-running notcutts.py on the fresh PDFs reproduces items.csv exactly. All 7 PDF pages were rendered and read by eye (including the two-column Drinks and Children's menus and the small/regular columns) and all 122 items were matched independently against pdftotext -layout output (name words and kcal figure together): 0 differ. Vegetarian and pork/beef tags agree with the menus' own (V)/(Ve) marks and dish names. Printed as is, but unusually high for a starter/dessert: Creamy Stilton Mushrooms 996 kcal and Rhubarb and Ginger Torte 1214 kcal (festive menu); no second figure exists to cross-check them.
